description: This file defines the FileLoader class for managing file loading in kustomize, including handling remote files, git repositories, and local filesystem paths, with methods for creating loaders, loading files, and handling repositories.

classes.name: FileLoader
classes.description: A class that manages loading files from local filesystem, remote URLs, or git repositories, with methods for creating loaders, loading files, and handling repositories.

methods.name: Repo
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to the repository containing the root, if created from a URL.

methods.name: Root
methods.description: Returns the absolute root path for relative file loading.

methods.name: NewLoaderOrDie
methods.description: Creates a new FileLoader instance at a specified directory, terminating on error.

methods.name: newLoaderAtConfirmedDir
methods.description: Internal function to instantiate a FileLoader with a given root directory.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new loader relative to the current loader, handling git URLs and local paths.

methods.name: newLoaderAtGitClone
methods.description: Creates a loader for a cloned git repository in a temporary directory.

methods.name: errIfGitContainmentViolation
methods.description: Checks if a base directory is outside the containing git repository.

methods.name: containingRepo
methods.description: Recursively searches referrers for a git repository associated with the loader.

methods.name: errIfArgEqualOrHigher
methods.description: Detects if a candidate root is equal or higher in the directory hierarchy, indicating a cycle.

methods.name: errIfRepoCycle
methods.description: Detects if a new repository URL would create a cycle with existing repositories.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads the content of a file at a given path, handling remote URLs and local paths.

methods.name: httpClientGetContent
methods.description: Fetches content from a URL via HTTP, handling errors and response status.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Runs cleanup procedures for the loader.
